title: Amazing app, just needs a quick fix
body:
Yo, this app is seriously amazing. I’ve been using it for like a year now and I’m obsessed — everything’s super smooth, love the design, and I’ve got a pretty big list going.

But lately, idk if y’all pushed an update or something broke, but it’s been lagging hard when I open it. Like, it just freezes for a good 10–15 seconds, shows nothing, and I have to force close it and try again. And even then, same thing — lag, then finally loads.

Would be awesome if you could look into it. Other than that, absolute top-tier app. Huge thanks to the devs — you crushed it!

title: An alright app, with a hefty price
body:
Looks and works good enough. Calendar view is kinda neat. I like it. 

Main screen could’ve been bit more intuitive. I don’t see why reordering can’t be done via drag ‘n drop versus separate “reorder” menu. Having contextual options on long press (remember 3D touch? me neither) would’ve been nice. Quick options to reset and delete are appreciated.

I cannot possibly justify spending any more than one-time-purchase of $12 to gain shortcuts compatibility (only thing I really desire). Remember the good ‘ol days, when the every single app didn’t have a subscription, and could’ve be purchased outright? I miss those times. 

Also consider localizing prices to different regions with different economic backgrounds. Maybe in US 22 bucks/year isn’t much, yet I don’t see how people in poorer countries can justify the price. Localized pricing for digital goods is a well-researched topic to help penetrate growing markets and increase both sales and overall revenue.
